notes.title: What I've been Working on and What’s Coming!
notes.notes: [p]🚨 [b]Major Progress Update[/b] 🚨 Patch notes monthly on [url="https://discord.gg/Jebvx5resR" style="button" buttoncolor="#4e37fb"]discord [/url][/p][p]Over the last few months, [b]Vaifurion[/b] has grown significantly across all areas—gameplay systems, UI polish, and foundational balance changes. Here's a quick summary of the most impactful additions and current in-progress features:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚔️ Gameplay & Systems[/h3][list][*][p]All collectible cards added, with many now animated or in wallpaper-friendly format[/p][/*][*][p]Prestige system fully reworked with powerful [b]Prestige Perks[/b] unlock tree[/p][/*][*][p]New skills added including the latest [b]Persistence[/b][/p][/*][*][p]More effect cards added: [b]Cleanse[/b], [b]Attack Boost[/b], [b]Lightning Reflexes[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Equipment system overhauled: gear now has effects and new drop logic[/p][/*][*][p]Dismantle system and skill multipliers rebalanced[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting system refined with [b]bi-directional UI[/b] and scalable pricing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamble card system[/b] completely reworked[/p][/*][*][p]EXP and prestige scaling updated for smoother growth[/p][/*][*][p][b]AFK coin earning[/b] while offline[/p][/*][*][p][b]Daily Rewards[/b] system introduced — claim a special lootbox each day[/p][/*][*][p]Level 10 now grants a free equipment item[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina click cost reduced, auto-clicks can now crit, and crit scaling improved[/p][/*][*][p]Full backend rewrite of [b]drop rate logic[/b] for stability and future scalability[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧭 UI & Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Progress page[/b] to track overall account milestones[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gallery page[/b] added for viewing unlocked cards and artwork[/p][/*][*][p]“[b]How to Play[/b]” section and improved first-time guidance for new players[/p][/*][*][p]Multi-lootbox opening interface reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Lootbox panel now includes updated stat indicators and better feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Card previews now have navigation arrows and expand options[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom tooltips[/b], message prompts, and patch notes viewer added[/p][/*][*][p]New ambient themes, side particle effects, and toggle for visual performance[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🏆 Achievements[/h3][list][*][p]Achievements now give [b]actual rewards[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Unlock dates and progress tracking now visible[/p][/*][*][p]New achievements added and old ones stabilized[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎵 Music & Ambience[/h3][list][*][p]Over [b]40 new tracks[/b] added to the game’s playlist[/p][/*][*][p]New ambient effects like [b]rain[/b], [b]rivers[/b], and [b]birds[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Volume sliders and ambience mode now fully implemented[/p][/*][*][p]New exclusive music track added to the Workshop[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 In Progress[/h3][list][*][p][b]Lore Acts[/b] are being unlocked progressively for story-driven progression[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deck builder[/b] that allows card leveling, unlocking perks and visuals[/p][/*][*][p][b]Material crafting system[/b] for exclusive lootboxes based on rare ingredients[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]If you haven’t already, wishlist it to stay in the loop for the full release. The game will be free to play.[/b] [/h3]
